full_state_convention: Every oracle enumerates all16 cells. Base homeUSD alice0 bob20 carol10 admin0; homeEUR alice8 bob9 carol0 admin0; awayEUR carol11; every other cell0. Fields not explicitly changed remain byte/value exact. Each fixture records the full capability list, claim list, lifecycle clock, actual command/event/index/pre/post/receipt/output sequence and exact failure including tentative diagnostics. Required malformed-source siblings are separate independent runs, not continuations after sticky failure. Fixtures must construct valid registry/catalog/footprints and actual capability permission for wrong-shape inner successes. Broad permission is a test precondition, never lifecycle ownership. F20 compares an independently expected value4 against the actual OutputPort balance snapshot; outputs are not arbitrary literal-return functions.
